marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots tonight and Tuesday. Rain or snow becoming periods of snow near midnight with a
risk of freezing drizzle. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
precipitation. Temperatures plus 3 falling to minus 2 Tuesday
morning. <br/>
